off._doc: Identity-OFF (mock) raw-DSP driver settings (basyx-off/dsp-flow.js). Only used when driving the mock arm; the ON arm uses the shared harness via consumerManagementUrl.

_live_verify.audience: must start with the provider's own DSP url = http://{org.factoryx.library.hostname}:8090/dsp -> dsp-native-basyx. Confirm against MockValidationService.getOwnDspUrl at smoke.
_live_verify.providerDspBase: k6 posts here from the host; 8090 is published, so localhost:8090 works. Token AUDIENCE stays the container url (above) — request target and token claim are different things.
_live_verify.assetIdSelector: RESOLVED 2026-06-26: target a REGULAR shell DataAsset (seed it first; this is the Bruno shell e38a0f92-...), NOT an *ApiAsset — *ApiAsset entries are write-forward proxies and 404 on a GET pull. The driver auto-skips *ApiAsset datasets if the selector doesn't match.
_live_verify.pullRewrite: the TransferStart endpoint uses the container hostname; rewritten to localhost:8090 for the host-side pull. If docker-hoster resolves dsp-native-basyx on the host, the rewrite is harmless.
_live_verify.transferFormat: dct:format on the TransferRequestMessage; confirm the provider accepts HttpData-PULL for the ApiAsset.

payload.note: BaSyx has no separate data plane (the AAS repo IS the data plane, synchronous GET) -> payload-sweep is not applicable; transfer/EDR half is degenerate (methodology Gk.RQ4).

_notes.connector: DSP-Native BaSyx. ON arm = org.factoryx.library.validationservice=mvd, driven by an EDC consumer-controlplane (docker-compose.monitoring.yaml).
_notes.networking: bridge network 'dsp-native-basyx'. providerDspAddress is a CONTAINER hostname because the EDC consumer (inside the network) dials it; consumerManagementUrl is a HOST-mapped port (29010) because k6 runs on the host.
_notes.provider_id: org.factoryx.library.id = did:web:provider-idhub:user:provider (becomes client_id in STS + aud check).
_notes.no_management_api: BaSyx provider has no EDC Management API -> seed.enabled=false; data is pre-seeded in MongoDB. seedProvider()/seedAssets() are no-ops, so catalog-sweep (Gk.RQ5) and payload-sweep are EDC-only.
_notes.TBD_verify_at_smoke: Phase B3: confirm (1) catalog.assetIdSelector matches a real pre-seeded asset @id (live probe showed ShellsApiAsset / SubmodelsApiAsset); (2) the EDR endpoint is host-reachable — if BaSyx returns a container address, set edr.useEdrEndpoint=false and a concrete dataPlanePublicUrl path.
_notes.off_arm: Phase B3: the mock arm drops the EDC consumer, so this consumerManagementUrl path serves the ON (mvd) arm only; the OFF (mock) arm needs the raw-DSP mock-token driver.
